collection.name: railDerailments
collection.doc: 🚆 Derailment action on a railway bridge (EN 1991-2, 6.7.1): design situation I (vehicles stay in the track area on the deck) or II, the vertical line load, its loaded length and its offset from the track axis the design assumes.

fields.name: situation
fields.doc: 🚆 i | ii: design situation I or II of the derailment (anything else is an invalid input).

fields.name: assumed_line_load
fields.doc: 🏋️ Vertical line load [N/m] along the track the design assumes for the derailed vehicles.

fields.name: loaded_length
fields.doc: ↔️ Length [m] over which the line load acts along the track.

fields.name: offset
fields.doc: ↕️ Distance [m] of the line load from the track axis, transverse to the track.
